mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FO_IDX_CODE ( INFO_TYPE, SHRN_ISCD, STND_ISCD, KOR_NAME, ATM_CLS_CODE, ACPR, MMSC_CLS_CODE, UNAS_SHRN_ISCD, UNAS_KOR_NAME ) VALUES ( #{infoType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stndIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{korName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{atmClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{acpr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mmscClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{unasShrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{unasKorName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

MERGE INTO FO_IDX_CODE t USING DUAL ON (t.INFO_TYPE = #{infoType} AND t.STND_ISCD = #{stndIscd}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.SHRN_ISCD = #{shrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.KOR_NAME = #{korName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.ATM_CLS_CODE = #{atmClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.ACPR = #{acpr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.MMSC_CLS_CODE = #{mmscClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.UNAS_SHRN_ISCD = #{unasShrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.UNAS_KOR_NAME = #{unasKorName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( INFO_TYPE, SHRN_ISCD, STND_ISCD, KOR_NAME, ATM_CLS_CODE, ACPR, MMSC_CLS_CODE, UNAS_SHRN_ISCD, UNAS_KOR_NAME ) VALUES ( #{infoType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stndIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{korName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{atmClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{acpr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mmscClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{unasShrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{unasKorName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
